name: boolean
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (true), (CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN)) AS t(c)

name: tinyint
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (CAST(-7 AS TINYINT)), (CAST(NULL AS TINYINT)) AS t(c)

name: smallint
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (CAST(300 AS SMALLINT)), (CAST(NULL AS SMALLINT)) AS t(c)

name: int
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (2147483647), (CAST(NULL AS INT)) AS t(c)

name: bigint_small
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (9007199254740992L), (CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)) AS t(c)

name: bigint_large
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (9007199254740993L), (CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)) AS t(c)

name: float
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (CAST(1.5 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(NULL AS FLOAT)) AS t(c)

name: double
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (CAST(0.1 AS DOUBLE)), (CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)) AS t(c)

name: string
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES ('naïve ✓'), (CAST(NULL AS STRING)) AS t(c)

name: binary
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (X'00FF10'), (CAST(NULL AS BINARY)) AS t(c)

name: decimal
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (CAST(12345678.91 AS DECIMAL(10,2))), (CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS t(c)

name: date
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (DATE '2026-11-05'), (CAST(NULL AS DATE)) AS t(c)

name: timestamp
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (TIMESTAMP '2026-11-05 10:11:12.123456'), (CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP)) AS t(c)

name: timestamp_ntz
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (TIMESTAMP_NTZ '2026-11-05 10:11:12.123456'), (CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) AS t(c)

name: interval_day_time
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (INTERVAL '1 02:03:04.5' DAY TO SECOND), (CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL DAY TO SECOND)) AS t(c)

name: interval_year_month
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (INTERVAL '1-2' YEAR TO MONTH), (CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL YEAR TO MONTH)) AS t(c)

name: interval_calendar
sql: SELECT make_interval(0, 3, 0, 2, 1, 0, 0) AS c

name: array
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (array(1, NULL, 3)), (CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<INT>)) AS t(c)

name: map
sql: SELECT c FROM VALUES (map('a', 1, 'b', 2)), (CAST(NULL AS MAP<STRING, INT>)) AS t(c)

name: struct
sql: SELECT named_struct('x', 1, 'y', 'z') AS c UNION ALL SELECT CAST(NULL AS STRUCT<x INT, y STRING>)

name: null
sql: SELECT NULL AS c

name: variant
sql: SELECT parse_json('{"a": 1}') AS c
